string.text: Spawn NPCs with chat nicknames\n(Independent setting; A-Life above does not need to be enabled)
Hello, stalker.
Hey. I have seen you somewhere before.
No, you must be mistaken.
Why don't you go to hell...
What's with that mouth? Been a while since you caught a bullet?
I'll send you to the other side right now, you hear me?
All right, sorry. I'm in a bad mood today.
Got any work?
Listen, don't ask why, but I need novice PDAs. Bring me %d of them. I'll make it worth your while.
All right, I'll bring them if I find any.
I need %d working novice PDAs. Bring them over when you have them and I will pay you.
Here are your PDAs.
Thanks, here's your reward.
I cannot pay you right now. Keep the PDAs and come back later.
See you around.
%s: collect novice PDAs
%s asked me to bring him %d novice PDAs. What does he need them for? I could use them myself. Oh well, maybe he'll make it worth my while.
and a random class I-IV artifact
and a random modificat
and a random hypermodificat
